articles.title: Standard Chartered to acquire remainder of subsidiary Zodia Custody
articles.snippet: The bank's offer to acquire the slice of Zodia Custody it doesn't already own has been accepted by the firm's other shareholders and noteholders.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot, North America's largest bitcoin ATM operator, files for bankruptcy
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Depot, the largest bitcoin ATM operator in North America and publicly listed on Nasdaq, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

articles.title: THORChain’s RUNE Token Plunges Double Digits After $10M Exploit, Trading Halt
articles.snippet: The liquidity protocol halted operations after blockchain researchers identified a suspected $10 million breach across multiple networks.
